observations: PlayStation 4 Pro console with Star Wars Battlefront II 'Galactic Empire' and 'Rebel Alliance' branding.
Three-tier chassis design confirms it is a Pro model.
Two standard black DualShock 4 wireless controllers are shown.
One HDMI cable and one power cable with a UK-style three-pin plug are present.
The text 'PS4' and 'STAR WARS' is visible on the front edge of the console in photo 0.
Watermark 'GAMEARENAOFFICAL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' visible on the image.
The console surface shows some smudges and light dust.

identity.model: PlayStation 4 Pro Star Wars Battlefront II Edition

claims.evidence: The three-tier design and 'PS4' branding in photo 0 are specific to the Pro model.
Requires a clear photo of the factory warranty seals on the rear of the console.
Requires a video of the console running a demanding game for at least 10 minutes.
Requires testing of HDMI, USB, and power ports.
The Star Wars edition console originally came with a themed controller featuring Star Wars logos; photo 0 shows two standard black controllers.
The receipt is mentioned but not shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or has a faulty APU (Blue Light of Death).
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the PlayStation home screen.

risks.risk: Internal components may have been tampered with or poorly repaired.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the warranty seals on the back of the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a previously repaired unit

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be unable to read games.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network.
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Photo of the warranty seals on the back of the console.
Video of the console powered on, showing the system software and a game running from a disc.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned.
Video demonstrating both controllers working without stick drift.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a PS4 Pro Star Wars Edition. It is priced at its worst-case state (non-functional and previously repaired) until the seller provides proof of operation and intact factory seals.
